shots.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create a polished first-page title illustration for a children's picture book, portrait 1024x1536 pixels, full bleed, one coherent scene.
Input images: Image 1 is a reference ONLY for portrait title-page composition and large elegant integrated storybook serif typography; exclude its tractor and forest subject. Image 2 is the canonical cottage bath nook and family visual identity reference. Image 3 is a supporting reference for the tiny baby Mr. PomPom's face and baby proportions.
Scene: the same intimate curved-timber cottage washroom, golden lamplight, warm plaster and natural wooden floor, round blue twilight window, a wide round wooden tub with metal bands on a braided dry mat. Preserve the lovely dimensional animated storybook rendering, fine spines and warm expressive faces of images 2 and 3.
Composition: reserve a naturally calm warm dark timber/plaster upper third for beautifully readable large cream book-title lettering, integrated into the picture, no separate banner. Keep the bath and characters in the lower two thirds, with room to see their faces and the little rinse stream clearly. Slightly wider eye-level camera so the room and family tell the story.
Exactly THREE hedgehogs: larger Mama standing beside the tub, older Mr. PinPin happily sitting in its shallow water with both forepaws visible resting near the inner rim, and TINY baby Mr. PomPom safely seated beside the tub on the dry mat in a cream towel. Baby's whole body is only about 50–60 percent of older PinPin's standing height, with the baby proportions shown in image 3. Mama gently rinses older PinPin's crown/back with a small cream ceramic pitcher, a delicate visible arc/stream of water like a soft shower. Her other forepaw rests reassuringly on the tub rim. The happy older child looks toward Mama; baby watches them.
Text, verbatim, large and elegant in the upper third: first title 'Мистер Пин-Пин', below it 'Дом, милый дом'. Both lines must be correctly spelled Cyrillic, comfortably inside the page, cream storybook serif lettering with strong contrast and professional balanced spacing. Split into additional lines only if needed for large legibility. No other text.
Constraints: coherent anatomy, two forelimbs and two hindlimbs per character with sensible occlusion, no duplicated limbs, distinct adult/older child/tiny baby sizes. Full-bleed single image, no frame, no collage, no modern shower stall or modern plumbing, no tractor, no extra animals, no unnecessary props, no watermark. Warm cozy calm bath time at home, not a bathroom advertisement.
